features.title: SLICE machine: round-robin slice select (RRBN) and the robin icon
Landing pads: fill bytes left in the cleared unused functions
POLY machine: parameter pages show and edit the source track
POLY machine: one playhead cursor per voice on SRC page 2
Virtual MIDI Loopback: a MIDI track with CHAN at TRK1-TRK8 plays an audio track without a cable, with the TRK number display
POLY machine: voice allocation (free voice first, then steal)
POLY machine: mute follows the track a note came from
POLY machine: held notes release across a pattern switch
Fix: a note released and re-triggered in the same audio tick no longer hangs
Chain Recording: the recorder fills a sample chain one slot at a time (encoder D sets the slot count, armed by the user or re-armed automatically)
CFO oscillator: the CFOO machine, a 3-oscillator 8-bit FM synth, with its own SRC page, knobs, value names, icon and LFO destinations

Portamento and legato: PORT and LEG on every audio track's TRIG page, saved with the sound and lockable per trig; with LEG on, a note before the last one's LEN ends glides and keeps the amp envelope running
